notes.title: What?! The Next Apocalypse Party Game is... a Card Roguelike?!
notes.content:
Oi~ Long time no see, folks!

Miss those days of blasting demons [strike]while picking up trash[/strike]? Don't worry, your old friends at Breaker Games are back to stir things up again!

Remember that apocalyptic tavern you loved to hate? Yep, we're back where it all began. But this time, we're swapping bullets for... cards!

We're thrilled to introduce our brand-new game—
[h2]Apokerlypse!![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42820120/e59f182c7e225f57c1ba883d37ad0a71d5333235.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42820120/0148122bdc3e614b7a39b0ae5a46eaa60419edf9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42820120/fc14326a8a188391e7cf6142e2fa1aee359bff3a.png[/img]

It's a [b]card strategy roguelike[/b] inspired by classic poker games, but we've twisted the rules into something completely wild! (In the best way possible, of course!)

Here, you'll play as a uniquely skilled post-apocalyptic card shark, using wacky [Demon Chips] to bend the rules, combining them with slick [Hero Abilities] and powerful [Spell Cards] to outwit and outplay player ghosts (data from real players) from around the globe!

Simply put: Your favorite weirdos (heroes) from Apocalypse Party are back, but the game's completely flipped! Forget PVE bullet hell – this is asynchronous PvP madness at the card table! Real friends settle scores with cards, right? Bring it on!

[h3]OK, the REALLY important stuff (pay attention!)[/h3]
[b]▶ New Title Reveal![/b] The Steam store page for Apokerlypse is LIVE NOW! Go check it out, and PLEASE hit that Wishlist button! Wishlist it! Wishlist it! Please！
     ✧ Apokerlypse Steam Store Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3481020/_/
[b]▶ Global Playtest Starts NOW![/b] Wanna try this "unconventional" card game early? We've got 1000 limited spots for the Global Playtest! Yep, usual deal: first come, first served! Head to the new store page NOW to request access, get a sneak peek, and then smash that feedback button to tell us EVERYTHING!
     ✧ Request Playtest Access via the store page link above!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42820120/7ffd3ccc721a94fdac0e92611b977467bd67259e.png[/img]

[h3]Finally, a massive thank you for all your patience and for sticking with us. [/h3]
Apokerlypse is a completely new take on the Apocalypse Party universe, and we genuinely hope it brings you a different kind of chaotic fun!

OK, enough talk. Same old tavern, brand new game! Looking forward to getting absolutely crushed by your crazy strategies (or maybe schooling you vets myself)!

[h2]The new party starts NOW![/h2]

Cheers,
The Entire Breaker Games Team
(Hopefully, we'll lose less hair this time...)

notes.title: Here We Go, Players! "Apocalypse Party" is Officially Live!
notes.content:
Heyyy Players and Friends,
This is Wilson, and it's been a while!
Today, I am thrilled to share some fantastic news with you all. After dedicating myself fully to the creative process for a long time, it's finally the moment to reveal: the sequel to "Project Zero," titled "Apocalypse Party," is officially live!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42820120/864a91e25eb6a1ceb977f9eda60649869ebae435.png[/img]

"Apocalypse Party" marks a monumental leap both in quality and quantity compared to its predecessor:
[list]
[*] Over 500 talent options, with the majority being mechanics-based talents
[*] 35 characters, each featuring a diverse array of unique skills
[*] More than 100 different melee and ranged weapons
[*] Several powerful special moves, an endless mode, and much more
[/list]

Unleash your creativity with various builds to mow down hordes of zombies and revel in the thrill of battle! The game also introduces tougher elite monsters and brand-new bosses, providing greater challenges that require both strategic thinking and skillful execution.
And if you find the battle getting tough, don't worry – you're not alone in this! "Apocalypse Party" supports up to 3-player co-op. So, call on your friends and dive into the fray together!

For more details, please follow this portal →  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2351560/Apocalypse_Party/]Apocalypse Party[/url]

I want to extend my heartfelt thanks for your enduring support and love for "Project Zero." I hope "Apocalypse Party" brings you even more joy and excitement! 

Let the party begin!!!

Best regards,
Wilson

notes.title: Apocalypse Party Steam Fest
notes.content:
Apocalypse Party will be officially launched in November.
The new work still adheres to the design concept of the original work, which is refreshing, grass-cutting, roguelike, and yet challenging.
On this basis we make it richer and more perfect. And it will bring a joyful experience for many people.

Thank you to the players of the Project Zero for their continued support.
During the Steam Fest, we received a large number of blessings from players!

thank you all!


If you are interested, please visit our new games, add to your wishlist, play the demo, or watch our live broadcast.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2351560/2/

notes.title: Coming 2023: Dive into the Next Chapter with ‘Project Zero 2: Apocalypse Party’!
notes.content:
'Project Zero' is not the end but rather the gateway to 'Project Zero 2: Apocalypse Party'. Here, you'll experience an array of brand-new combat styles, meet companions of diverse personalities but with a unified goal. Whether you choose to go solo or team up for battle, the choice is yours. 

But it's not just you and your friends who are growing stronger. Unprecedented and fierce enemies await your challenge!

Whether you're a new companion looking to join or an old friend aiming to fulfill an unfinished mission, we look forward to meeting you in 'Project Zero 2: Apocalypse Party'!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42820120/55959b379d707402315321c2aafa4d7bbd3839b5.png[/img]

notes.title: The New Project Zero Game is coming!
notes.content:
Attention fans of “Project Zero”! We are very grateful for your support and encouragement along the way~ The ideas and suggestions you provided are very interesting and considerable, and we really benefited a lot. 
In order to fulfill our common wish and create a better game, we decided to open up a new battlefield → the orthodox sequel [b]Project Zero 2: Apocalypse[/b]
The new game has more than 10 times more skills compared with the previous one, and there are at least 300+ mechanism-type skills! Massive entries and free combinations will bring rich and varied combat methods! The enemies will also complete the “evolution” and appear as monsters that can use skills and particular actions! There are also powerful BOSSes that have not appeared in the previous work joining the battlefield, bringing huge challenges to players! In addition, the long-awaited online muti-player mode will also be launched at the same time, and you can finally have a good time with your friends~ The portal to “Zero Plan 2: Apocalypse Party” has been opened👉[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2351560/2/]Project Zero 2: Apocalypse Party[/url]. What are you waiting for? Hurry up and join us!
